headerDisplay: Control a network-connected Vizio SmartCast soundbar. After restarting Homebridge, pair the soundbar separately in Apple Home using Add Accessory → More Options and your Homebridge PIN.

name.title: Soundbar Name
name.description: Keep this name unchanged after pairing; it is part of the accessory's identity. You can rename the accessory inside Apple Home.

ip.title: Soundbar IP Address or Hostname
ip.description: For example, 192.168.1.50 or soundbar.local:9000. Omit https://. Use a DHCP reservation so this address stays stable.

authToken.title: SmartCast Authentication Token (optional)
authToken.description: An existing SmartCast token, only if your model requires authentication. This plugin does not initiate SmartCast pairing.

pollInterval.title: State Refresh Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: Use 10–3600 seconds to reflect physical remote changes, or 0 to disable background refresh.

requestTimeout.title: Request Timeout (milliseconds)
requestTimeout.description: Per-request timeout. Commands requiring a read and write have a total deadline of twice this value.

debug.title: Verbose Debug Logging
debug.description: Log all SmartCast requests and responses, polling, state changes, command queues, and authentication status. Works without Homebridge global debug mode. Authentication secrets are redacted. Commands are always logged even when this is off. Restart the soundbar child bridge after changing this setting.
